text:
anya (PM): Heads-up — Acme just asked for a regional reservation product: reserved capacity per region with hard isolation and predictable p95 latency SLA. They want this as an add-on to Hosted (no Dedicated). Thoughts?

jules (sales): They offered a 6-month commit if we can guarantee region-level isolation + SLA. Wants pricing guidance asap.

kevin (eng): Important callouts: hosted isolation would need separate worker pools per region + traffic shaping. Also need per-customer KV cache partitioning to avoid noisy neighbors.

natalie (billing): Pricing tack: could be a flat monthly regional fee + per-request uplift. Maybe tier it by provisioned concurrent slots.

anya (PM): Proposal sketch: "Regional Reserve Add-on" SKU with 3 flavors: small(2 slots), medium(8 slots), large(32 slots). 3mo minimum commit. Include a 99.9% p95 SLA for in-region requests.

dylan (CS): From CS: customers will want predictable fallbacks if we miss SLA. Need playbook: credit windows, immediate failovers to global pool, and notification templates.

kevin (eng): Implementation risk: autoscaler changes + routing policy. Short-term hack: soft-reserve where we prioritize routing but still share underlying machines; long-term: strict segregation. soft-reserve reduces cost but weaker isolation (SLA implications).

anya (PM): Launch criteria ideas: 1) infra spike test page — no >10% p95 variance under 2x baseline, 2) automated canary across 3 regions, 3) billing instrumentation that maps reservation -> invoice line, 4) CS runbook + incident playbook written.

natalie (billing): Must ensure metering surface: reserved_slots, used_slots_peak, cross-region failovers. Also need contract language for refunds/credits on SLA misses.

jules (sales): Customer asks: ability to burst beyond reservation for short windows without penalty. How would that look?

kevin (eng): Burst options: queued bursts (throttle), or overflow to shared pool with an overage rate. Overage should be > reserved per-unit cost. Simpler: allow controlled burst to shared pool + higher per-token charge.

anya (PM): Can we draft an MVP that keeps things simple: medium-risk route = soft-reserve + burst-to-shared w/ overage pricing + explicit SLA credit table? We ship faster and validate demand.

kevin (eng): Agree. Plan: soft-reserve implementation in 6–8 weeks, add strict-reserve as roadmap item with infra cost model. Need infra estimate before commit.

natalie (billing): I'll draft price tiers and SLA credit table. Will also flag tax/regulatory items for region-specific contracts.

dylan (CS): I'll author the CS runbook and the customer notification templates.

anya (PM): Next steps: 
- kevin: infra estimate + risk doc by EOD Friday
- natalie: provisional pricing + SLA credit draft by Tue
- jules: confirm Acme commitment window and get us legal contact
- dylan: runbook skeleton by Mon

ops-bot: Reminder — please add "regional-reserve" feature flag to feature-queue and set priority = high for Q3 planning.

jules (sales): I'll push back on the 3mo min if Acme asks; prefer 6mo but flexible.

anya (PM): OK. We'll reconvene after docs. Short thread but big impact on packaging roadmap — flagging for roadmap sync. :eyes:
